subtitle: How a Hoysala general carved a dynasty’s mature vision into a single star of stone

panels.shot: epic wide shot from slightly above, temple complex glowing in evening light with Soma Dandanayaka foregrounded in silhouette
panels.action: Soma Dandanayaka stands at the edge of the star-shaped Keshava temple platform at Somanathapura, hands clasped behind his back, gazing over the triple shikhara skyline as the Kaveri plain stretches beyond.

dialogue.text: In 13th-century Hoysala Karnataka, not a king but a battle-hardened general, Soma Dandanayaka, vowed to fix his age forever in stone—and built Somanathapura’s perfect star.

i18n.hi: तेरहवीं सदी के होयसला कर्नाटक में, राजा नहीं, रणझझेले सेनानायक सोमा दंडनायक ने पत्थर में अपने युग को बांधने की ठानी — और रचा सोमनाथपुर का परफेक्ट तारा।

panels.shot: slow push-in from a bird’s-eye over the Kaveri river valley towards a small fortified town
panels.action: From high above, the lush Kaveri river winds past fields and groves toward the walled settlement of Somanathapura, where Soma Dandanayaka rides in on horseback, dust rising behind his small retinue.

dialogue.text: The inscription names the place clearly—Somanathapura on the Kaveri—and names the man: Soma Dandanayaka, general of Hoysala Narasimha III, riding not to war, but to build.

i18n.hi: शिलालेख साफ बोलता है — कावेरी किनारे सोमनाथपुर — और एक नाम: सोमा दंडनायक, होयसला नरसिम्ह तृतीय का सेनापति, जो इस बार युद्ध नहीं, निर्माण की सवारी पर है।

panels.shot: medium shot at town gate, low angle framing Soma against distant hill temples
panels.action: At the entrance of Somanathapura, Soma dismounts, his armor dulled by use, greeted by local elders as simple shrines and tiled roofs rise behind them.

dialogue.text: By the 1260s, the Hoysalas had filled Karnataka’s hills with temples. Yet Soma’s record is unusual: here, a military officer, not a king, claims the role of temple-maker.

i18n.hi: १२६० के दशक तक होयसलों ने कर्नाटक की पहाड़ियों मंदिरों से भर दी थीं। फिर भी सोमा का लेख अनोखा है: यहाँ मंदिर-निर्माता का दावा एक सैनिक करता है, राजा नहीं।

panels.shot: intimate interior wide, inside a modest hall where plans are spread on the floor
panels.action: Inside a simple hall, Soma kneels over palm-leaf plans and rough stone markers, his finger tracing a star-shaped outline as local craftsmen watch quietly.

dialogue.text: Hoysala art had reached a mature, intricate form—star-shaped plans, dense friezes, towering shikharas. At Somanathapura, Soma chose that full-grown style as his language of devotion.

i18n.hi: होयसला कला पककर बेहद सूक्ष्म हो चुकी थी — ताराकृति योजना, घनी पट्टियाँ, ऊँचे शिखर। सोमनाथपुर में सोमा ने इसी पुरे-पन को अपनी भक्ति की भाषा चुना।

panels.shot: ground-level plan view, looking down on chalked star outlines and Soma’s hand placing a central marker
panels.action: On packed earth within an empty compound, star-shaped outlines are marked in lime; Soma places a stone peg at the center where three sanctum positions intersect.

dialogue.text: The inscription speaks of a temple for Keshava, with three garbhagrihas. Soma’s choice is clear: a triple-shrined Vaishnava temple, arranged on a star-like platform, balanced and complete.

i18n.hi: शिलालेख केशव के मंदिर का ज़िक्र करता है, तीन गर्भगृहों वाला। सोमा का इरादा साफ है: तीन-अलय वाला वैष्णव मंदिर, तारा-जैसे मंच पर संतुलित, पूरा और सुव्यवस्थित।

panels.shot: dynamic construction wide, scaffolds rising around half-built stone walls
panels.action: Masons work atop bamboo scaffolds, fitting grey soapstone blocks into jagged zigzag walls as Soma watches from below, hand resting on his sword-hilt, eyes fixed on the emerging form.

dialogue.text: Block by block, the stellate jagati rose. Unlike some royal projects that remained unfinished, Somanathapura’s enclosure and towers would reach their intended height under Soma’s steady oversight.

i18n.hi: घन घन रखकर तारानुमा जगती उठती गई। कई राज-मंदिर अधूरे रह गए, पर सोमनाथपुर की परिक्रमापथ और मीनारें सोमा की सतर्क निगरानी में मनचाही ऊँचाई तक पहुँचती हैं।

panels.shot: close-up profile of Soma and a chief sculptor examining a carved panel
panels.action: Soma and a senior sculptor stand beside a newly carved outer wall panel, its friezes of elephants and processions still bearing chisel marks, as they appraise the detail in silence.

dialogue.speaker: soma_dandanayaka
dialogue.text: These stones must speak clearly of our age, long after we are gone.

i18n.hi: इन पत्थरों को हमारी उम्र की आवाज़ बनना होगा, हमारे बाद भी साफ सुनाई देने वाली।

panels.shot: low-angle view along the temple base, friezes receding into distance with Soma small in frame
panels.action: From the temple base, bands of carved figures—elephants, horsemen, dancers, deities—run in ordered rows along the star-shaped projections, while Soma is seen walking along them, counting quietly.

dialogue.text: UNESCO’s modern dossier will call this a high point of Hoysala style. Long before that verdict, Soma insists on legible order—each band a disciplined procession in stone.

i18n.hi: यूनेस्को की आधुनिक फाइल इसे होयसला शैली की चोटी कहेगी। उससे बहुत पहले, सोमा सख़्त अनुशासन चाहता है — हर पट्टी पत्थर में सजी हुई, पढ़ने लायक शोभायात्रा।

panels.shot: interior wide shot of the mandapa under construction, pillars rising like a forest
panels.action: Inside the growing mandapa, lathe-turned pillars catch filtered light, their polished shafts gleaming as artisans polish carvings and Soma stands amid them, dwarfed by the forest of stone.

dialogue.text: Within, the Hoysala taste for ornate pillars and patterned ceilings unfolds. This is mature design—no experimental roughness, but confident repetition and refinement under a patron who cares.

i18n.hi: अंदर होयसला की सजीले स्तंभों और जालीदार छतों की पसंद खुलकर खिलती है। यह परिपक्व डिज़ाइन है — कोई खुरदरा प्रयोग नहीं, बल्कि निश्चिंत दोहराव और निखार, ऐसे संरक्षक के तहत जो सचमुच चिंतित है।

panels.shot: dramatic symmetrical frontal wide of the three shikharas completed, Soma tiny at the base
panels.action: All three shikharas now rise skyward above the star platform, tiered and complete, as Soma stands alone at the jagati edge at dawn, looking up at the freshly finished skyline.

dialogue.text: Here lies a quiet triumph: unlike at many Hoysala sites where towers fell or were never finished, Somanathapura’s three shikharas stand intact, a rare full expression of the form.

i18n.hi: यहीं एक शांत विजय छिपी है: जहाँ कई होयसला स्थलों पर शिखर टूट गए या कभी पूरे ही नहीं हुए, सोमनाथपुर के तीनों शिखर साबुत खड़े हैं — रूप की दुर्लभ पूरी अभिव्यक्ति।

panels.shot: shadowy interior shot of the central sanctum doorway, empty pedestal inside
panels.action: In the dim central garbhagriha, an empty pedestal sits where the Keshava image once stood; Soma’s shadowed figure watches a priest prepare the space, unaware of the fate that idol will later meet.

dialogue.text: The inscription honours Keshava. Today, the main image is gone. We do not know when or how—but the stone record lets us glimpse the moment when that sanctum first came alive.

i18n.hi: शिलालेख केशव का मान करता है। आज मुख्य प्रतिमा नहीं है। कब और कैसे, हम नहीं जानते — पर पत्थर की लिखत हमें वह पल दिखा जाती है जब यह गर्भगृह पहली बार प्राण-जागृत हुआ।

panels.shot: medium shot inside one lateral shrine with an installed deity, Soma bowing
panels.action: In a side shrine, a Vaishnava icon sits in place, adorned with fresh flowers, as Soma bows with joined palms, his sword laid aside at the threshold.

dialogue.text: Narasimha III, Soma’s lord, leans in records toward Jain piety. Yet his general builds a Vaishnava temple. Hoysala patronage flowed across sects and ranks more freely than modern labels suggest.

i18n.hi: नरसिम्ह तृतीय, सोमा का नाथ, अभिलेखों में जैन भक्तिपथ की ओर झुकता दिखता है। फिर भी उसका सेनानायक वैष्णव मंदिर गढ़ता है। होयसला संरक्षण संप्रदाय और पद की सीमाएँ आज के नामों से कहीं ज़्यादा सहजता से लाँघता था।

panels.shot: close-up of stone inscription panel being carved, Soma overseeing
panels.action: A stone-scribe chisels old Kannada letters into a tablet near the temple entrance, while Soma stands over him, the freshly cut lines catching the afternoon sun.

dialogue.text: On one slab, the consecration record fixes the date and the deed: under Narasimha III, Soma Dandanayaka founds Somanathapura and builds this temple. Service becomes memory, carved in script.

i18n.hi: एक फलक पर प्रतिष्ठा का लेख तिथि और कर्म दोनों बाँधता है: नरसिम्ह तृतीय के अधीन सोमा दंडनायक सोमनाथपुर बसाता है और यह मंदिर उठाता है। सेवा स्मृति बन जाती है, अक्षरों में तराशी हुई।

panels.shot: evening courtyard wide shot of the first ritual gathering, lamps glowing
panels.action: The temple courtyard fills with townspeople as lamps flicker along the jagati; priests move in procession while Soma stands near the entrance, watching the ritual unfold with restrained satisfaction.

dialogue.speaker: soma_dandanayaka
dialogue.text: May this place guard the grace and the craft of our time.

i18n.hi: यह स्थल हमारे युग की कृपा और कारीगरी की रक्षा करे।

panels.shot: time-lapse style wide, blending past and present with faint modern visitors among ancient carvings
panels.action: The same star-shaped platform centuries later, its carvings weathered but sharp, modern visitors walking along the friezes, while a faint ghostly image of Soma lingers at the far edge.

dialogue.text: Centuries pass. The dynasty fades. Yet scholars, travellers, and UNESCO dossiers turn back to this quiet town, praising the clarity and fullness of the Hoysala vision kept here.

i18n.hi: सदियाँ बीतती हैं। वंश ओझल हो जाता है। पर विद्वान, यात्री और यूनेस्को की फाइलें फिर इसी शांत नगर की ओर मुड़ती हैं, यहाँ सँभाली गई होयसला दृष्टि की स्पष्टता और पूर्णता को सराहती हुई।

panels.shot: final contemplative low-angle close-up on Soma’s carved name in the inscription, fingers of a modern visitor gently tracing it
panels.action: A modern hand gently traces the carved name “Soma Dandanayaka” on the inscription slab, the letters worn but legible, as the silhouette of the triple-shrined temple rises softly out of focus behind.

dialogue.text: Soma Dandanayaka did what many patrons forget: he turned his loyalty and power into enduring beauty, proving that service to a king can also be a quiet service to posterity.

i18n.hi: सोमा दंडनायक ने वह किया जो कई संरक्षक भूल जाते हैं: अपनी निष्ठा और शक्ति को टिकाऊ सौंदर्य में बदल दिया, दिखा दिया कि राजा की सेवा भविष्य की शांत सेवा भी बन सकती है।

title_i18n.hi: सोमा ने गढ़ा सबसे परफेक्ट तारा

subtitle_i18n.en: How a Hoysala general carved a dynasty’s mature vision into a single star of stone
subtitle_i18n.hi: कैसे एक होयसला सेनापति ने पूरी वंश की परिपक्व दृष्टि एक पत्थर के तारे में तराशी
